name: a-priori convergence results extracted from the literature
procedure: apriori_literature.py: arXiv (4 queries), 3 papers read, LLM extracts results + assumptions + evaluation for the re-entrant case; code checks quotes and compares with reentrant_score.json

predictions.L1_found: at least one paper yields a result for uniform or graded h-refinement with its regularity assumption
predictions.L2_quotes: at least 80% of the extracted results carry a quote found verbatim (first 60 characters) in the paper
predictions.L3_agree: at least 75% of the extracted predictions that map to a measured family agree with the observed beta within 0.1
predictions.L4_grading_condition: at least one extracted graded-mesh result states a grading condition equivalent to g >= p / lambda (or beta-grading with beta <= lambda / p)
